fusions.name: Muzzle Clap
fusions.desc: Fires a point-blank blast that deals 12 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles long and knocks it back 3 tiles. Each has a 40% chance to be left [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Plate-Breaker Round
fusions.desc: Fires a round at the first enemy it meets that deals 32 damage and ignores its armour.

fusions.name: Loophole Post
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to set a shielded firing post beside you for 15 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it fires on an enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage.

fusions.name: Answering Shot
fusions.desc: Each time anything other than fire hurts you, a shot leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 4 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
